import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    price_list = inputs["price_list"].copy()

    # --- expression: sku_norm = UPPER(TRIM(sku)) ---
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku"].astype("object")
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku_norm"].apply(
        lambda v: v.strip().upper() if isinstance(v, str) else np.nan
    )

    price_list["sku_norm"] = price_list["sku"].astype("object")
    price_list["sku_norm"] = price_list["sku_norm"].apply(
        lambda v: v.strip().upper() if isinstance(v, str) else np.nan
    )

    # --- lookup ---
    orders_reset = orders.reset_index(drop=False).rename(columns={"index": "_row_id"})

    pl = price_list[["list_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "valid_from"]]

    merged = orders_reset.merge(
        pl,
        on="sku_norm",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_pl"),
    )

    # condition: valid_from <= order_date ; NaN sku_norm never matches (merge already drops those)
    merged = merged[merged["valid_from"] <= merged["order_date"]]

    if not merged.empty:
        merged_sorted = merged.sort_values(
            ["_row_id", "valid_from", "list_id"],
            ascending=[True, False, True],
        )
        best = merged_sorted.groupby("_row_id", as_index=False).first()
        best = best[["_row_id", "unit_price"]]
    else:
        best = pd.DataFrame(columns=["_row_id", "unit_price"])

    result = orders_reset.merge(best, on="_row_id", how="left", suffixes=("", "_lk"))

    matched_mask = result["unit_price"].notna()
    result["price_flag"] = np.where(matched_mask, "OK", "NO_PRICE")
    result.loc[~matched_mask, "unit_price"] = 0.0
    result["unit_price"] = result["unit_price"].astype("float64")

    # --- expression: ext_amount = qty * unit_price ---
    result["ext_amount"] = result["qty"] * result["unit_price"]

    # --- router ---
    qty = result["qty"]
    ext_amount = result["ext_amount"]
    price_flag = result["price_flag"]

    cond_review = (price_flag == "NO_PRICE") | qty.isna() | (qty >= 100)
    cond_bulk = ext_amount >= 1000
    cond_small = ext_amount < 50

    cond_review = cond_review.fillna(False)
    cond_bulk = cond_bulk.fillna(False)
    cond_small = cond_small.fillna(False)

    route = np.select(
        [cond_review.to_numpy(), cond_bulk.to_numpy(), cond_small.to_numpy()],
        ["REVIEW", "BULK", "SMALL"],
        default="STANDARD",
    )
    result["route"] = route

    # --- output1: order_enriched ---
    order_enriched = result[["order_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "route"]].copy()

    # --- aggregator ---
    grouped = result.groupby(["route", "order_date"], as_index=False, dropna=False).agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "size"),
        total_ext=("ext_amount", "sum"),
    )
    grouped["total_ext"] = grouped["total_ext"].fillna(0.0)

    route_daily = grouped[["route", "order_date", "order_count", "total_ext"]].copy()

    return {
        "order_enriched": order_enriched,
        "route_daily": route_daily,
    }
